record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare PSYSHIELD_BASH: Stantler (3 stars, passive STANTLER) and Wyrdeer (4 stars, no passive); both range 1, maxPP 100. The strategy is shared; unit differences are the star index into the damage table. Units not listed are not covered.
record.summary: Needs a target in range (inherited requiresTarget = true). Asks the board helper getFarthestTargetCoordinateAvailablePlace for a destination: normally a free cell next to the farthest targettable enemy (Manhattan distance, not necessarily the cast target), but the helper keeps the cell chosen for an EARLIER nearer enemy when a farther enemy has no free adjacent cell (retained-earlier-cell case), and only when no cell was selected at all does it fall back to the closest free cell to the farthest enemy, which need not be adjacent (executed: retained cell (4,1) next to the nearer enemy; fallback (7,3), two cells from the enemy at (7,5)). If a destination exists, the enemies standing on the supercover line from the caster's current cell to that destination are collected (before the caster moves), then the caster moves there with moveTo(x, y, board, false): an unforced self-move that does not consult canBeMoved (executed: a locked caster holding Heavy Duty Boots still moves). Regardless of whether a destination existed, after the movement opportunity and before any damage the caster requests Protect for a fixed 1000 ms (no AP or crit scaling; an existing Protect is not refreshed and an enraged caster gets none). If the hit set is empty - no destination, or no enemy on the line - the ORIGINAL CAST TARGET is added without another team check (executed with an ally as the cast target and with an off-line enemy). Each collected enemy takes requested SPECIAL damage 50 (Stantler, 3 stars) / 60 (Wyrdeer, 4 stars) (table 30 / 40 / 50 / 60 / 120, fallback 120) via handleSpecialDamage with the caster as attacker and the cast's crit flag (crit needs ABILITY_CRIT).

targeting.who: every enemy-team entity standing on the cells between the caster and the helper's destination (both endpoints included); the cast target only as fallback when none was collected
targeting.note: The destination comes from the helper's scan of targettable enemies, not from the cast target. The destination is a free cell, so no enemy stands on it; the caster's own cell is on the line but filtered out as same-team. Cells are read before the caster moves.

geometry.shape: line (supercover) from the caster's starting cell to the destination cell chosen by the helper

effects.target: each collected enemy (once per enemy, set semantics)
effects.scaling: requested = table[stars-1] ?? 120. handleSpecialDamage multiplies by (1 + AP/100) (apBoost default true), x2 once with DOUBLE_DAMAGE, x1.2 with STRANGE_STEAM_BOARD_EFFECT, and on a crit by 1 + (critPower - 1) x the target's crit reduction factor (Rocky Helmet / Black Augurite). Crit needs ABILITY_CRIT.
effects.resolution: applied = requested after those multipliers, handed to PokemonState.handleDamage: divided by (1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x speDef of the target), rounded up with a minimum of 1, absorbed first by the target's shield. The returned takenDamage is not read by this strategy (how handleDamage builds it, and its exceptions, are in core-mechanics.md section J1); the requested and the applied amount differ. The damage is dealt after the caster moved and after its Protect was requested; the caster's own Protect does not affect damage dealt by it.

declaredRaw.description: moveTo the destination chosen by getFarthestTargetCoordinateAvailablePlace

effects.scaling: none from stars, AP or crit
effects.resolution: moveTo(x, y, board, false): toMovingState, board.swapCells (the destination is free, so the caster just changes cell), cooldown = 100 for faster retargeting; canBeMoved is checked only for forced displacement (forcedDisplacement is false here), so a locked caster or one holding Heavy Duty Boots still moves. The destination is the helper's retained earlier cell when the farthest enemy has no free adjacent cell, or the nonadjacent closest-free-cell fallback; no move when the helper returns null (no targettable enemy or no free cell).

effects.scaling: none from stars, AP or crit (a fixed 1000)
effects.resolution: triggerProtect(1000): ignored when the caster is already protected (no refresh) or enraged; otherwise protect = true and protectCooldown = 1000, cleared by updateProtect. While protected the caster takes 0 from basic and ability damage and cannot gain positive PP or ordinary healing (status.protect, not Rune Protect; core-mechanics.md section J). Applied whether or not a destination was found.

statusEffects.scaling: none (a fixed 1000 ms request; no AP, crit or star scaling)
statusEffects.resolution: not stackable, not applied to an enraged caster
statusEffects.guards: triggerProtect does nothing when the caster already has Protect (no refresh) or is enraged; applied whether or not a destination existed
statusEffects.applicationOrder: after the movement opportunity (moveTo, when a destination exists) and before the damage calls
statusEffects.combatEffect: status.protect on the caster for the cited damage, PP and healing paths (see the PROTECT record for what was read); ends in updateProtect after 1000 ms

starBehavior.note: Only the damage depends on stars (index stars-1 of the casting entity). Protect duration and destination logic are star-independent. The 30 / 40 (1-2 stars) and 120 (5 stars / fallback) entries are declared in the table but unused by the two bound baseline classes; the full table 30 / 40 / 50 / 60 / 120 is kept. Whether other mechanics change a star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: Selection in board.ts:568-630 (same helper as FLAME_CHARGE, NUZZLE and AQUA_JET; the retained-earlier-cell and nonadjacent-fallback cases were executed with the real helper on an 8x6 stand-in board): board.forEach scans cells row by row; only targettable enemies whose Manhattan distance from the caster is strictly greater than the running maximum are considered, so equal distances keep the first one scanned. For such an enemy the running cell maximum is reset and its free adjacent cells are compared by distance from the caster, the first strictly farther one winning; selectedCell is replaced only when that enemy has at least one free adjacent cell, so if a farther enemy has none, the cell chosen for an earlier, nearer enemy is retained (and that enemy is the helper's target). The fallback (the free cell closest by Manhattan distance to the farthest enemy, anywhere on the board, possibly not adjacent) runs only if selectedCell is still null at the end. If the helper returns null the caster does not move and only the cast target is hit.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state, no modes. Each cast repositions the caster again; a cast while Protect is still active does not refresh it.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: damage 50 (STANTLER) / 60 (WYRDEER) and a fixed 1000 ms Protect. Requested damage = raw x (1 + AP/100) x DOUBLE_DAMAGE x steam x crit factor; applied after speDef, minimum 1 and shield; the returned takenDamage is not read by this strategy (section J1). Protect: requested 1000 ms, applied only when the caster is neither protected nor enraged. Raw damage table 30 / 40 / 50 / 60 / 120 (STANTLER 3 stars raw 50, WYRDEER 4 stars raw 60).
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, silence, target acquisition for a requiresTarget ability) - only the castAbility gate was read

What the STANTLER passive does: Passive.STANTLER appears only in the Stantler class and the Passive enum in app/ (git grep at the pinned commit), with no handler found there; any effect elsewhere is not covered
unresolved: How common the retained-selectedCell case is on real boards was not examined; the same helper nuance applies to FLAME_CHARGE, NUZZLE and AQUA_JET
Whether the caster can already stand on a cell with an enemy-free line (e.g. destination equal to current cell) was not examined
Whether the two units reach a different star count than the factory value (Stantler evolves to Wyrdeer through a state-based rule) was not examined
No routing uncertainties were queued for this record

Evidence: source reading, mechanical checks and executed probes. The pinned helper text (getFarthestTargetCoordinateAvailablePlace, getClosestAvailablePlace, getCellsBetween, swapCells, moveTo, triggerProtect, isTargettableBy) and the real PsyshieldBashStrategy strategy text were run against stand-in units and boards with controlled callbacks (probes/pinned-helper-probe.mjs, sections IMPORT_RECHECK_3); the whole ability in a real fight, targeting and timing before the cast, and full battles were NOT executed, and nothing was observed in a live game. Executed (BLUE_TEAM / RED_TEAM stand-in units, damage calls are controlled recorders): the order move (unforced) -> Protect 1000 -> damage; on-line enemies hit and an off-line cast target not; retained earlier cell and nonadjacent fallback; no destination -> Protect 1000 then the original target (an ally) damaged; locked caster with boots still moves; existing Protect keeps 300 ms; enraged caster gets none.
